text:
Ava: Quick idea — run a compact launch experiment this month tying a short benchmark narrative, a 30-min webinar, and a 3-day credit drip + prompt-template pack for new signups. Goal: 15% lift in activation (first successful generation) and better demo-to-paid conversion. Thoughts?

Jamal: I like it. Can we make the webinar a look-behind at benchmarks vs. alternative APIs? Engineers love numbers. :bar_chart:

Priya: +1. Keep webinar title non-salesy: 'Getting predictable LLM economics: test results from real apps' — pull in a small case study. Also recommend 3 prompt templates per persona (productivity, customer support, search).

Luca: Routing q: do we funnel registrants into starter credits immediately or gate until they attend? My vote: give credits up front but smaller (e.g., 150 tokens) and double them for attendees. That preserves incentive while letting us measure friction.

Ava: Good call. Proposed flow: 1) sign-up -> 150 starter tokens + prompt pack link, 2) attend -> +150 tokens + follow-up prompt workshop, 3) post-attend 48h nudge with onboarding checklist. We A/B test immediate vs. gated credits.

Maya: Draft of signup microcopy (quick): `Try Redwood Inference — 150 starter tokens + 3 ready-to-use prompts. Join the live benchmark demo to double your credits.` Want two variants for A/B: one focused on credits, one focused on templates.

Priya: Variant B (templates-first) suggestion: `Start building with 3 curated prompts and 150 tokens — see real latency & cost wins in our live demo.` Keep subject lines short for webinar emails.

Jamal: Tracking needs: utm_source=launch_rally, utm_campaign=mar24_microw, variant=A|B, cohort=attended|no_show. Also tag user metadata: first_generation_ts, webinar_attended_ts, credit_bonus_awarded. campaign-bot: I've created tracking tags: `launch_rally_mar24` and `microweb_A_B`.

campaign-bot: event created: `microweb-mar24-2026` — registration opens in 48h. Reminders scheduled: -72h, -24h, +1h, +24h.

Luca: For the benchmark narrative, pull 2 short examples: one low-latency burst use (chatbot) and one throughput-heavy batch embed job (search). Keep numbers: p50 latency, p95 tail, cost per 1k tokens relative to baseline. Priya can draft the slide with 2 charts.

Priya: I'll build slides. Need help getting p95 numbers for the Llama-2-13B quantized variant vs. openapi baseline. @Jamal can you gate access to the perf sheet?

Jamal: Sharing the perf sheet now: https://redwood.internal/perf/mar24-rally (please don't share externally). I added a 'slides' tab with canned charts.

Ava: Promotion plan: 1) launch post on Product Hunt style channels + Twitter threads, 2) two email cohorts (trial users <7d, non-converted trials 7-30d), 3) in-app banner with quick CTA, 4) partner shoutouts. Draft copy and schedule by EOD Wed.

Maya: I'll do the email cadence. Proposed cadence: Day 0 (invitation), Day 3 (reminder + highlight use case), Day 6 (last chance + double credits reminder).

Luca: One more test: deliver a small set of tailored prompt templates by persona via a single-click import for the Playground. That should shorten time-to-first-success. Engineering: is import hook ready?

Jamal: Hook is ready-ish — needs a tiny manifest format. Example: 
```
{
  "name": "customer-support-quick-reply",
  "prompts": ["Summarize the ticket in 2 bullets", "Draft empathetic reply"]
}
```
We can ship a pared-down version for the experiment.

Priya: Great. Action items: Ava — finalize experiment brief + KPI sheet; Maya — email and copy variants; Jamal — perf sheet access + import hook final; Luca — in-app banner + Playground import flow; Me (Priya) — slides + prompt packs. Let's sync 30m tomorrow.

Ava: I put a calendar invite for 09:30 PT. Target launch window: Mar 24–31 micro-experiment. Keep the launch small and measurable. :rocket:

Maya: Noted. I'll prepare two subject lines per variant and a short GIF demo for the in-app banner.

Jamal: I'll wire the event attribution and set up a funnel in Looker to capture first_generation -> first_success -> paid. Expected sample size ~3k registrants for statistical confidence; we'll monitor daily.

Ava: Perfect. If anyone wants to tweak the copy, drop drafts here before 5pm today. Thanks everyone — excited to test the activation nudge angle. :sparkles:
